headline: Divided Sectors Lead War’s Latest Ledger
war_summary: The latest ledger shows no victor, with base turnover still concentrated in a narrow belt of contested sectors. Fisherman’s Row is the liveliest board this edition: 35 events in 24 hours, nine in the latest two-hour window, though all nine strategic bases currently stand Colonial. Godcrofts has recorded 62 daily events and three in six hours, yet its nine bases likewise remain Colonial-held. Weathered Expanse remains a major divided front, with 33 events, six in the latest two hours, and holdings split four Warden to five Colonial; Frostmarch supplies 17 of those events. Stlican Shelf is also divided five to three, with one base neutral and 31 events in the day, including four at the cutoff. Stonecradle’s ledger records nine events around a four-Warden, five-Colonial split, while Tempest Island has four fresh events and remains entirely Colonial-held. Elsewhere, activity is generally quiet or one-sided, though the heavy casualty figures in Callahan’s Passage and other established fronts show that fighting has not vanished beyond the turnover sectors.
